followUpFindings: The cross-protocol alias data-loss defect confirmed by the disposable loopback probe on 2054edc is addressed by transferTransactionBatch. Content search is implemented; directory comparison and the remaining search-lifecycle, viewer, navigation and transfer audits are still required. Bookmark management and file properties are implemented and verified.

completionRule: Implementation plus current functional, keyboard and visual evidence is required; source inspection or an older release alone does not prove completion.

directoryComparisonBatch.behavior: Synchronization copies explicitly reviewed differences without automatic deletion. Replaced versions remain on disk until removed by the user.
